questions.question: Before beginning work under raised heavy equipment, what is the safest action?
options: Rely on the hydraulic system to hold it up
Ask a coworker to watch it
questions.explanation: Hydraulic systems can fail. Approved stands or blocking must support raised equipment.

questions.category: A2 — Implement hybrid and electric vehicle safety protocols
questions.question: When working on hybrid or electric equipment, what should be done before servicing high-voltage components?
options: Follow lockout/tagout and verify zero voltage
questions.explanation: High-voltage systems require isolation, lockout/tagout, and voltage verification before work begins.

questions.category: A3 — Use hand tools, power tools, and shop equipment
questions.question: What is the correct tool to tighten a bolt to a specified value?
questions.explanation: A torque wrench applies a specific tightening force to fasteners.

questions.question: Why should damaged threads on a bolt be corrected or replaced?
questions.explanation: Damaged threads can prevent proper torque and clamping force.

questions.question: What should be checked before using a lifting chain?
questions.explanation: Lifting equipment must be inspected and rated for the load.
